summary: Comprehensive testing of BraidsCommunity MVP completed. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests PASS (100%) across auth, hairstyles, subscription gating, hairdresser detail with badges & blur, search filtering, availability slots, full booking lifecycle (create → check-in → complete → review), favorites, portfolio (with Standard 10-item cap), availability updates, notifications, and seed idempotency. Frontend: All 20+ manual flows working — login with demo autofill, home hero+trending grid+category chips, search with subscription gating banner ('Showing top 3 · Unlock unlimited'), hairstyle detail → gated hairdresser list → hairdresser profile with tabs (Portfolio/Reviews/About), badges (Verified Pro, Rising Talent), booking screen (style/date-14-day/slots, Pay-at-counter notice), bookings tab with Upcoming/Past + Check-in/Cancel buttons, subscription toggle between Standard/Unlimited (mock), pro dashboard, pro portfolio with 6 seeded photos, pro availability weekday editor, and new hairdresser registration correctly routes to /pro/dashboard. Subscription plan toggle is MOCKED (intentional per spec).

issues: Tab bar buttons have no testID attributes — testing agents must use text selectors or router.push URLs. Recommend adding testID='tab-home', 'tab-search', 'tab-bookings', 'tab-profile' via tabBarButton or listeners for better automation.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID attributes to bottom tab bar buttons for better automated testing (currently only labels work via text selectors)
(Cosmetic) Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from an RN library; low priority
MOCKED SUBSCRIPTION toggle confirmed working as intended per spec (no payment processor call)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 722-line file — consider modularizing into routers/ (auth, bookings, hairdressers, etc.) if the app grows beyond MVP
JWT_SECRET has a dev fallback default — acceptable for MVP but should be enforced in production via required env var

Route ordering: /hairdressers/{hid} is declared before /hairdressers/me/dashboard and PUT /hairdressers/me — currently safe because paths differ in segment count/method, but adding a GET /hairdressers/me would shadow. Consider moving /me routes before dynamic /{hid}
auto_cancel_late job runs every 1 minute (not 15) — this is fine and safe (idempotent), just note the 15-min window is enforced via 'cutoff' calculation

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (login, home, search, hairstyle detail, hairdresser profile, booking, bookings tab, profile, subscription toggle, pro dashboard, portfolio, availability, registration→pro routing)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded demo data. All ad-hoc test users prefixed with 'test_' and use @example.com domain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 31 backend pytest tests pass. Rerun with: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Test suite is idempotent — creates/cleans TEST_ prefixed data. Frontend testIDs: home uses style-hero-{id}/style-card-{id}, hairstyle detail uses hd-{id} for pro cards, booking uses style-{id}/date-YYYY-MM-DD/slot-{iso}/confirm-book, subscription uses select-standard/select-unlimited. Bottom tab bar has no testIDs — use text selectors (page.get_by_text('Search').first) or router URLs (/home, /search, /bookings, /profile).
rca_of_issue: No production bugs found. Fully functional MVP.
